evidence: Modifies txospenderindex and extracts shared logic into BaseIndex and index/block_seq.h under src/index/.
rationale: Significantly reduces txospenderindex resource usage by shrinking key entries by 33% (from 18 to 12 bytes). Previous experiments noted in the discussion showed the database size dropping from ~84GB to ~62GB alongside lower indexing times, while also decoupling the index from raw file positions to facilitate pruned mode.
